integrity: Proved by local Poisson factorial expansion and explicit geometry; numerical checker supplements but does not substitute for the proof or assess originality.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-parameter small-time asymptotics for two colours and finite exclusion volume; no all-time density ordering, jamming law, more than two colours, or infinite-dimensional uniformity. The prior-priority assessment is not independently performed.
title: A positive third-order density gap between random and priority colouring in two-layer adsorption
